value.title: Trust recovery guidance needs fixture coverage

sections.name: body
sections.value: PR264 R1: automatic next_key used the observed highlight, but manual refusal guidance returned default-row keys. Check both recovery instructions and automatic navigation against moved-highlight and missing-highlight fixtures. A read-only CI-backed review gate would avoid dependency-dependent development checks in detached no-node_modules review checkouts; exact-head CI and downloaded job-specific JUnit supplied the suite evidence here.
